verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only built-in AI summaries and automatic labeling of scanned mail. These are passive AI features, not an assistant the user can hand tasks to, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. A built-in assistant is a fair question for a virtual-mail SaaS, so the axis applies, but no such assistant is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
